derivation: Generated by tools/import_kicad_board.py from the vendor's own KiCad footprint. Pad centres are exact to three decimal places in millimetres, scaled at 8.0 px/mm from a 24.54 x 20.75 mm extent including a 1.0 mm margin. Pin names joined from the symbol library on pad number. Nothing here was measured off an image.
assumption: Every `pin` is null: that field is the rcontrol pin index of a PICSimLab board implementation (webui/pinmap.py), and none exists for this board. `chip_pin` and `chip_index` are null on every pad here, and `pindefs` names no package, because no board-support package covers this board at all -- no Zephyr board and no vendor core publishes a STM32C5 XIAO (OH-26). Each pad says the same in its own `why_null`. The pin view reports every pad as not modelled, and will until the vendor publishes something to read.

pindefs.derivation: Generated by tools/import_pindefs.py, which found no board-support package covering this board: `packages` is empty because there are none to name, not because none was read. Every pad's `chip_pin` is null and says so in its own `why_null`.
